mapper.select: SELECT C.NR_ITEM_NM || '(' || B.BDSR_RGN_ETC_CNTE || ')' AS region, A.INPT_DTM AS writingDateTime, 'Stage ' || A.BDSR_STEP_CTG_CD as stage, A.BDSR_SZ_WDTH_VAL::float || '/' || A.BDSR_SZ_VLIN_VAL::float || '/' || A.BDSR_SZ_DPTH_VAL::float as size, (SELECT Z.COMN_CD_NM FROM ODS.S_CCCCCSTE Z WHERE Z.COMN_GRP_CD = 'N0003001' AND Z.COMN_CD = A.BDSR_REC_DRSS_IMPL_TP_CD) as dressingAction, (SELECT Z.COMN_CD_NM FROM ODS.S_CCCCCSTE Z WHERE Z.COMN_GRP_CD = 'N0003000' AND Z.COMN_CD = D.BDSR_REC_DRSS_MTHD_CD) as dressingMethod, (SELECT Z.COMN_CD_NM FROM ODS.S_CCCCCSTE Z WHERE Z.COMN_GRP_CD = 'N0000286' AND Z.COMN_CD = E.BDSR_REC_DRSS_KND_CD) as dressingKind, (SELECT Z.DEPT_NM FROM ODS.S_PDEDBMSM Z WHERE Z.DEPT_CD = A.WRTR_PLWK_DEPT_CD) AS writingDeptNm, (SELECT Z.STF_NM FROM ODS.S_CNLRRUSD Z WHERE Z.STF_NO = A.FSR_STF_NO) as writerNm FROM ODS.S_MRNNRPCD A INNER JOIN ODS.S_MRNNRPAD B ON A.BDSR_REC_ID = B.BDSR_REC_ID INNER JOIN ODS.S_MRNNRIAM C ON B.BDSR_RGN_NR_ITEM_ID = C.NR_ITEM_ID INNER JOIN ODS.S_MRNNRPDE D ON A.BDSR_REC_ID = D.BDSR_REC_ID AND A.INPT_DTM = D.INPT_DTM AND A.WRT_SEQ = D.WRT_SEQ INNER JOIN ODS.S_MRNNRPFE E ON A.BDSR_REC_ID = E.BDSR_REC_ID AND A.INPT_DTM = E.INPT_DTM AND A.WRT_SEQ = E.WRT_SEQ WHERE A.PT_NO || '_' || A.INPT_DTM::DATE = #{keyId} AND A.LST_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY A.BDSR_REC_ID
